author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**

GO:0006000	fructose metabolic process
IEA with IPR013079

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC144.17c
https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC732.02c

* **Description of issue**

these are 6-phosphofructo-2-kinase

D-fructose 2,6-bisphosphate + H2O = D-fructose-6-phosphate + phosphate.

D-fructose-2,6-bisphosphate (F2,6BP) is not a metabolic intermediate that gets consumed or built into biomass. Instead, it is a regulatory molecule that controls the direction and rate of carbon flux through central metabolism (i.e glycolysis/glu oneogenesis)

-> not converted into fructose
